title: A McKean--Vlasov semigroup and its application to a martingale representation problem
summary: We introduce a McKean--Vlasov semigroup in the presence of common noise and study its first-order differential structure. Given a terminal functional $G$, the semigroup is defined by propagating the initial law through a reference conditional McKean--Vlasov flow. Using a finite-particle approximation and a diagonal/off-diagonal decomposition of the tangent processes, we identify the Lions derivative of the propagated functional and derive a backward representation along arbitrary admissible conditional law flows.
